results.title: Laos Signs Development Agreement for 1,275-MW Vilatsaphone Wind Project
results.content: On 17 November, the Lao government signed a Project Development Agreement (PDA) with two developers for the proposed 1,275-megawatt (MW) Vilatsaphone Wind Power Project in Savannakhet Province. Naseng-Wayo Renewable Resources Development & Investment Co., Ltd. and UPC Vietnam (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. If completed, Vilatsaphone would become Laos’ largest wind farm. results.title: Vientiane Launches LAK 400 Billion Road Project in Naxaythong, Xaythany
results.content: Vientiane authorities have launched a LAK 400.76 billion (USD 17.7 million) project to build 14.32 kilometers of reinforced concrete roads across Naxaythong and Xaythany districts. The Vientiane Department of Public Works and Transport and Phaengphone Road-Bridge Construction and Irrigation Sole Co., Ltd. held a construction launch ceremony on 18 November in Naxaythong District.
